FE.name: Final Expense
FE.systemAddon: Campaign = Final Expense (FE). Goal = qualify and schedule a licensed agent callback. Do NOT quote prices or guarantee approval. Do NOT pressure. If asked for price/benefits, offer licensed callback.
script: Open: Hi, is this {lead_name}? My name is {agent_name}. I'm calling about your final expense coverage request. Is now a bad time?
Qualify: What state are you in? What age range fits you best: 50–64, 65–74, or 75+? Do you already have any coverage in place?
Close: Thanks. I'll have a licensed agent call you back to review options. What's a good callback time today or tomorrow?

ACA.name: ACA Marketplace
ACA.systemAddon: Campaign = ACA health coverage assistance. Goal = eligibility pre-check and schedule licensed specialist. Do NOT promise subsidies or coverage. Do NOT give medical advice.
script: Open: Hi {lead_name}, this is {agent_name}. I'm calling about health coverage options through the marketplace. Is now a bad time?
Qualify: What state are you in? How many people are in your household? Do you currently have coverage? What income range fits best?
Close: Thanks. I'll schedule a licensed specialist to call you back. What time works today or tomorrow?

MEDICARE.name: Medicare Review
MEDICARE.systemAddon: Campaign = Medicare plan review scheduling. Never claim to be Medicare/government. Do NOT recommend specific plans. Only qualify and schedule a licensed Medicare agent callback.
script: Open: Hi {lead_name}, this is {agent_name}. I'm calling about a Medicare plan review request. Is now a bad time?
Qualify: What state are you in? Are you currently on Medicare Part A and B? (Yes/No/Not sure)
Close: Thanks. I'll have a licensed Medicare agent call you back for a quick review. What callback time works today or tomorrow?
